description: Search the DolfDarts encyclopedia (201 dart games) by text query with optional filters (category, mechanic, difficulty, player count, board type, max minutes). Returns matching games with their dolfdarts.com URLs.

boardType.description: Filter: only games played on this dartboard type. Most players have 'standard'; omit to include all 39 board types. Board ids and live game counts: browse_taxonomy (boards).

maxMinutes.description: Filter: estimated play time at or under this many minutes.

playerCount.description: Filter: games playable with this player count (min ≤ n ≤ max).

query.description: Search text matched across game name, alternate names, overview, and tags.

name: search_games
title: Search dart games
